#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;

    std::vector<int> dp(n + 2, 0);
    dp[0] = 1;
    int ans = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        int row = i;
        for (int j = row; j <= n; ++j) {
            if (((row + j) & 1) == 1) {
                ans = (ans + dp[j]) % MOD;
            }
            dp[j + 1] = (dp[j + 1] + dp[j]) % MOD;
        }
    }

    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
